title: Cisco security advisory (AV26-1073)
description: As of October 21, 2026, Cisco is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
Cisco IOS XR Software Release
	Multiple versions

Cisco Expressway Series Release
	Prior to X15.5.20

Cisco Cyber Vision Release
	Prior to 5.6.0

Cisco Secure FTD Software Release
	Multiple versions

Cisco Secure Client Release
	Prior to 5.1.20.333

Cisco Emergency Responder, Prime Collaboration Deployment, Unified CM, Unified CM IM&P, Unified CM SME, and Unity Connection Release
	Prior to 15SU5
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
